appProtection.purpose: Offer defensive app and business protection services across TryAMM while strengthening TryAMM's own security posture.
guardrails: no destructive testing without explicit written authorization
professional/legal/compliance review for regulated clients where needed

jacobieCompensationPathways.principle: Compensate Jacobie through a documented lawful structure tied to actual ownership, work, licensed IP, or approved profit-sharing—not an informal promise in code.
options: salary or hourly employment for actual work
independent-contractor payments where classification is legally appropriate
royalty or brand/IP licensing payments if Jacobie legally owns or licenses qualifying IP
equity or membership interest subject to company documents, securities/tax/legal review
family trust or succession structure established by qualified counsel
jacobieCompensationPathways.recommendedStart: Use a written role description and compensation agreement for real work performed, then separately document any ownership, royalty, profit-share or equity rights with attorney/CPA review.
